cues.en: Instructor: Welcome to this section of the course, which is all about ANOVAs.
cues.zh: 講師：歡迎來到這個專門介紹 ANOVA 的單元。

cues.en: I'm going to begin this section with two introductory videos, this one and the next one.
cues.zh: 單元開始會有兩支入門影片，就是這一支與下一支。

cues.en: And here I'm going to set things up and make sure that you understand everything that there is to know about ANOVAs except for how to actually do them.
cues.zh: 先鋪陳背景，確保除了實際操作方式之外，你對 ANOVA 需要知道的事情都已了解。

cues.en: So I think it's important to make sure that we're all on the same page, we all know the same terms, we are all using the same lingo, we know what an ANOVA is, when we would use an ANOVA
cues.zh: 我認為很重要的是，大家有共同基礎，知道相同術語，使用相同語言，了解 ANOVA 是什麼、何時使用，

cues.en: and when we wouldn't use an ANOVA, and then once we're through that understanding, then we can move to the math.
cues.zh: 何時不使用，理解之後再進入數學。

cues.en: It turns out actually the math behind an ANOVA isn't that difficult, and you will see this over the rest of this section.
cues.zh: 其實 ANOVA 背後的數學並不難，本單元接下來會看到。

cues.en: Okay, so let us begin.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: I'm gonna start by just defining ANOVA.
cues.zh: 首先定義 ANOVA。

cues.en: Maybe you already know this, but in case you don't, now you know.
cues.zh: 也許你已經知道，不過如果還不知道，現在就知道了。

cues.en: ANOVA stands for analysis of variance and the whole idea of an ANOVA is to examine patterns of variance in a dataset.
cues.zh: ANOVA 是 analysis of variance，也就是變異數分析，整個概念是檢視資料集中的變異模式。

cues.en: So basically we take all of the variance in the dataset and we say how much the variance is due to this factor, how much the variance is due to this factor.
cues.zh: 基本上，把資料集所有變異拿出來，問其中多少來自這個因子，多少來自那個因子。

cues.en: Is there more variance for this factor than this factor?
cues.zh: 這個因子的變異，比另一個因子更多嗎？

cues.en: It's really all about variance.
cues.zh: 一切都圍繞著變異數。

cues.en: So if you have any residual uncertainty about what variance means, how to compute it, how to interpret it, then I encourage you to pause the video
cues.zh: 如果對變異數的意義、計算或解讀還有疑問，建議先暫停影片，

cues.en: and pause this entire section and go back to earlier in the course where I introduce the idea of variance and standard deviation.
cues.zh: 也暫停整個單元，回到課程前面介紹變異數與標準差的地方。

cues.en: Same concept.
cues.zh: 是同樣的概念。

cues.en: So the goal of an ANOVA is to determine the effects of discrete independent variables, these are typically categorical variables,
cues.zh: ANOVA 的目標，是判定離散自變數，通常是類別變數，

cues.en: on a continuous dependent variable.
cues.zh: 對連續依變數的影響。

cues.en: Now I want to just give you a really quick example to help contextualize this statement and then I'm going to go into much more detail about specific examples in the rest of this video.
cues.zh: 先快速舉個例子，幫助理解這句話，影片稍後再詳細討論具體例子。

cues.en: So quick example.
cues.zh: 一個快速例子。

cues.en: Let's say we are doing some medical research at a hospital.
cues.zh: 假設在醫院進行醫學研究。

cues.en: We want to know the effects of a medication type and age group on how well a medication works to treat some disease or some condition.
cues.zh: 想知道藥物類型與年齡組別，如何影響藥物治療某種疾病或狀況的效果。

cues.en: So this is our example.
cues.zh: 這就是例子。

cues.en: We want to determine the effects of some independent variables, like the medication and age group, on a continuous dependent variable, and that is how well the medication actually treats
cues.zh: 我們想判定藥物與年齡組別這些自變數，對連續依變數的影響，也就是藥物實際治療

cues.en: the underlying condition.
cues.zh: 該狀況的成效。

cues.en: Okay, so later on in this section, you're gonna learn about how to actually compute an ANOVA in terms of the math and also in terms of implementing it in code.
cues.zh: 本單元稍後會學到，如何從數學與程式實作的角度，真正計算 ANOVA。

cues.en: But right now I want to talk about how to set up an analysis of variance in four steps.
cues.zh: 但現在先談如何用四個步驟，規劃變異數分析。

cues.en: So the first step is to maybe, you know, you could call this even step zero, is to review the experiment design and determine whether an ANOVA is really the appropriate method.
cues.zh: 第一步，也可以稱為第零步，是檢視實驗設計，判斷 ANOVA 是否真的合適。

cues.en: You know, ANOVA is not the right thing to do in all cases, and I will show you some examples later on in this lecture of experiments where an ANOVA
cues.zh: ANOVA 並非所有情況都適用，這堂稍後會展示一些實驗，ANOVA

cues.en: is actually the wrong analysis method.
cues.zh: 其實是錯誤的分析方法。

cues.en: So we first make sure that ANOVA is the appropriate method for this particular dataset, this experiment design.
cues.zh: 所以，先確認 ANOVA 適合這份資料集與實驗設計。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: Then step two is to identify the independent and dependent variables.
cues.zh: 第二步，辨識自變數與依變數。

cues.en: And I'll talk more in detail about step two.
cues.zh: 第二步稍後會更詳細說明。

cues.en: Actually, I'll talk in more detail about all these steps in a moment.
cues.zh: 其實所有步驟，稍後都會詳細說明。

cues.en: Step three is to create a table of factors and levels.
cues.zh: 第三步，建立因子與水準的表格。

cues.en: And here I say when possible because it's not always possible to create a simple table, but we can even think about what that table would look like even if we don't actually create it.
cues.zh: 這裡寫「如果可行」，因為不一定能建立簡單的表格，但即使不真正建立，也可以想像它會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: If you're not sure what factors and levels mean, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果不知道因子與水準的意思，不用擔心。

cues.en: I'm going to define that in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後就會定義。

cues.en: And then finally, step four is to compute the model and interpret the results.
cues.zh: 最後，第四步是計算模型並解讀結果。

cues.en: So step four is like the rest of this section, and I'm gonna spend most of this video and the next video talking about steps one through three.
cues.zh: 第四步會涵蓋本單元其他內容，而這支影片與下一支影片，大部分時間會談第一到第三步。

cues.en: So let's talk about step one.
cues.zh: 先談第一步。

cues.en: I'm gonna start this by giving an example of a research question and an experiment.
cues.zh: 從一個研究問題與實驗的例子開始。

cues.en: So our research goal is to test whether some new medications developed for COVID-19 are effective for different groups of people
cues.zh: 研究目標是檢驗，針對 COVID-19 開發的新藥，是否對不同群體的

cues.en: who are suffering from COVID-19.
cues.zh: COVID-19 患者有效。

cues.en: So highly relevant topical research goal.
cues.zh: 這是當時非常切合時事的研究目標。

cues.en: So here's our experiment, an overview of the experiment.
cues.zh: 以下是實驗概觀。

cues.en: We get a bunch of patients who are suffering from COVID-19.
cues.zh: 找來一群 COVID-19 患者。

cues.en: We randomly assign them to receive medication A or medication B or a placebo.
cues.zh: 隨機分派他們接受藥物 A、藥物 B，或安慰劑。

cues.en: If you're not familiar with this term, placebo, a placebo is like a fake pill that you would give someone and you tell them that it's an actual medication.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉安慰劑這個詞，它像一顆假藥丸，給某人服用，並告訴對方這是真的藥。

cues.en: And the point of having a placebo is you need to distinguish whether there is a actual physical chemical effect of the drug
cues.zh: 使用安慰劑，是因為需要區分，藥物是否真的具有生理化學作用，

cues.en: or whether there's a psychological effect of the drug because people think that they are receiving a medication, so they will get better on their own.
cues.zh: 還是因為人們以為自己接受藥物，因此自行好轉，也就是藥物的心理效果。

cues.en: So that would be called the placebo effect.
cues.zh: 這就稱為安慰劑效應。

cues.en: Okay, so we have three medications, a real medication, a different medication, and placebo.
cues.zh: 所以有三種藥物：一種真藥、另一種藥，以及安慰劑。

cues.en: And then we measure the disease severity after 10 days.
cues.zh: 接著量測 10 天後的疾病嚴重程度。

cues.en: And then we are also going to separate these patients into older.
cues.zh: 另外把患者分成年長組，

cues.en: In this case, I'm defining that as being over 50, versus younger, and I'm defining that as being less than 50 individuals.
cues.zh: 這裡定義為超過 50 歲，以及年輕組，這裡定義為小於 50 歲。

cues.en: Okay, so this is our research goal. This is our experiment.
cues.zh: 這是研究目標，這是實驗。

cues.en: Now, over the next several slides, I'm going to be referring back to this experiment.
cues.zh: 接下來幾張投影片，都會回頭引用這個實驗。

cues.en: So step two is to identify the independent variables and the dependent variables.
cues.zh: 第二步，辨識自變數與依變數。

cues.en: And remember that the dependent variables, which are also sometimes called the outcome variables, this is the variable that you are trying to explain variance in.
cues.zh: 記住，依變數有時也稱為結果變數，就是你想解釋其變異的變數。

cues.en: And the independent variables are the variables that you hope will explain the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 自變數則是希望能用來解釋依變數的變數。

cues.en: Independent variables are sometimes the things that you manipulate in the experiment, and sometimes they are things that are naturally occurring that you're not manipulating, but they are things that you are using
cues.zh: 自變數有時是實驗中操弄的項目，有時是自然存在、沒有操弄的項目，但我們用它們

cues.en: to explain variance in the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 來解釋依變數的變異。

cues.en: So if you like, pause the video, or maybe you can think of this really quick and determine the DV and the IVs for the previous example, the example I gave in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以暫停影片，或快速想想，判斷上一張投影片那個例子的依變數與自變數。

cues.en: Okay. Did you get it?
cues.zh: 想到了嗎？

cues.en: So the answer is that the IVs, we have two IVs, it's medication and it's age group.
cues.zh: 答案是有兩個自變數：藥物與年齡組別。

cues.en: And the dependent variable is the disease severity after 10 days.
cues.zh: 依變數是 10 天後的疾病嚴重程度。

cues.en: Okay, so that's a bit about step two.
cues.zh: 這就是第二步的簡介。

cues.en: Now step three is where we create a table of factors and levels.
cues.zh: 第三步，建立因子與水準的表格。

cues.en: So first I have to tell you what factors and levels mean, what these terms mean in the context of an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 首先說明因子與水準，在 ANOVA 脈絡下的意思。

cues.en: So the factors are like the dimensions of the independent variables.
cues.zh: 因子就像自變數的維度。

cues.en: When I show you this in the example, this will make more sense.
cues.zh: 用例子展示時，會更清楚。

cues.en: And the levels are these specific groups or these specific manipulations within each of the factors.
cues.zh: 水準則是各因子內的特定群組，或特定操弄。

cues.en: So in our thought experiment here, we have two factors, the medication and the age group, and the levels are A and B and placebo.
cues.zh: 這個思想實驗中，有藥物與年齡組別兩個因子，水準則有 A、B 與安慰劑。

cues.en: These are the levels within the medication factor.
cues.zh: 這些是藥物因子內的水準。

cues.en: And we have younger and older.
cues.zh: 另外有年輕與年長。

cues.en: These are the levels within the age factor.
cues.zh: 這些是年齡因子內的水準。

cues.en: So we have two factors and this factor, the medication factor has three levels 'cause there's three things that we are manipulating here, and the age factor has two levels.
cues.zh: 所以有兩個因子，藥物因子有三個水準，因為這裡操弄三種項目，而年齡因子有兩個水準。

cues.en: Now, we're not manipulating this, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，年齡不是我們操弄的。

cues.en: We can't randomly assign people to the old or young.
cues.zh: 不能把人隨機分派成年長或年輕。

cues.en: If that were the case, I would non-randomly assign myself to be a bit younger.
cues.zh: 如果可以，我會不隨機地把自己分派得年輕一點。

cues.en: So these are features that are naturally occurring and we are latching onto them.
cues.zh: 這些是自然存在的特徵，我們拿來使用。

cues.en: We're utilizing these as levels inside the factor age.
cues.zh: 把它們當成年齡因子中的水準。

cues.en: Okay, so here is what our table of factors and levels look like.
cues.zh: 這是因子與水準表格的樣子。

cues.en: So we have medication as one factor, age group as the other factor.
cues.zh: 藥物是一個因子，年齡組別是另一個因子。

cues.en: And here we have the levels listed as rows here and as columns here.
cues.zh: 水準在這裡列成各列，在這裡列成各欄。

cues.en: Of course, orientation is arbitrary.
cues.zh: 方向當然是任意的。

cues.en: You could put the medication over here and the age group over here.
cues.zh: 可以把藥物放這邊，年齡組別放那邊。

cues.en: Now, here's why I say when possible in parentheses.
cues.zh: 以下就是括號裡寫「如果可行」的原因。

cues.en: Imagine that in our experiment, we want to include a third factor, and maybe that third factor is the prior or existing health status of the patient.
cues.zh: 假設實驗中想加入第三個因子，例如患者過去或現有的健康狀況。

cues.en: So we want to separate the medication for individuals who are already healthy or who have some kind of preexisting condition
cues.zh: 想區分藥物對原本健康的人，或有某種既有疾病的人之影響，

cues.en: because it's already known that the disease COVID-19 is significantly worse in individuals who have some kind of preexisting medical condition.
cues.zh: 因為已經知道，有既有疾病的人，COVID-19 的嚴重程度會顯著較高。

cues.en: Now, the thing is that an ANOVA with three factors is fine.
cues.zh: 三個因子的 ANOVA 是可以的。

cues.en: There's nothing wrong with that.
cues.zh: 沒有問題。

cues.en: We can compute ANOVAs with many factors, but constructing this table with three factors means we would actually need a third dimension.
cues.zh: 可以計算具有許多因子的 ANOVA，但要替三個因子建立表格，其實需要第三個維度。

cues.en: So this would turn from a table into a cube if we wanted to have a third dimension here.
cues.zh: 如果要有第三個維度，這就會從表格變成立方體。

cues.en: So if you have one or two factors, you can construct a table like this.
cues.zh: 有一個或兩個因子時，可以建立這樣的表格。

cues.en: If you have three factors, then you can just imagine what that other factor would look like.
cues.zh: 如果有三個因子，可以想像第三個因子會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: You can imagine what that table would look like stretched out into 3D.
cues.zh: 想像把表格延伸到三維。

cues.en: Now, we have to be a little bit careful with the terminology here because there is something else called the ANOVA table, and you'll learn about the ANOVA table
cues.zh: 術語要稍微小心，因為另外有個東西也叫 ANOVA 表，稍後會學到 ANOVA 表，

cues.en: later on in this section and how to interpret it.
cues.zh: 以及如何解讀。

cues.en: The thing that is commonly referred to as the ANOVA table is a table that contains all of the results, all of the partitioning of the variances,
cues.zh: 一般所謂的 ANOVA 表，是包含所有結果、所有變異分割方式，

cues.en: the P values, the degrees of freedom, all that stuff is in the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: P 值、自由度等等的表格。

cues.en: This is not the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 這個不是 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: This is a table of factors and levels that are used in the analysis of variance.
cues.zh: 這是變異數分析所使用的因子與水準表。

cues.en: Now we get to step four, which is computing the model, the ANOVA, and interpreting the results.
cues.zh: 接著是第四步，計算 ANOVA 模型，並解讀結果。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna tell you about the math and the implementation details in later videos, but for now I just want to review with you the two main interpretations, or I guess there's three,
cues.zh: 數學與實作細節會在之後影片說明，目前先回顧 ANOVA 效果的兩種主要解讀，或者應該說三種，

cues.en: interpretation of the effects that we get from an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 也就是 ANOVA 得到的效果如何解讀。

cues.en: So first of all, we can get main effects, and a main effect means that one factor influences the dependent variable, even when completely ignoring all the other factors
cues.zh: 首先有主效應。主效應表示，即使完全忽略實驗中其他所有因子，某一因子仍會影響

cues.en: in the experiment.
cues.zh: 依變數。

cues.en: Then we have interactions between the factors.
cues.zh: 接著是因子之間的交互作用。

cues.en: And this means that the effect of one factor depends on the levels of another factor, and I'll give you examples of these in a moment.
cues.zh: 意思是一個因子的效果，取決於另一個因子的水準，稍後會舉例。

cues.en: And then finally, we have something called the intercept.
cues.zh: 最後，還有截距。

cues.en: And the intercept just means that the average of the dependent variables is different from zero.
cues.zh: 截距表示依變數的平均值不同於 0。

cues.en: Now, the intercept of the ANOVA is usually ignored.
cues.zh: ANOVA 的截距通常會被忽略。

cues.en: So it's often reported in the ANOVA table, but most people don't interpret the intercept.
cues.zh: 經常列在 ANOVA 表中，但大部分人不會解讀截距。

cues.en: It's usually not so relevant.
cues.zh: 通常不太相關。

cues.en: Okay, so here's an example.
cues.zh: 以下是一個例子。

cues.en: Here's a main effect of group.
cues.zh: 這是組別的主效應。

cues.en: If we find that young people's symptoms improve faster than older people's symptoms, it doesn't matter which type of medication they're taking, whether it's medication A or B or placebo.
cues.zh: 如果發現年輕人的症狀比年長者改善得快，而且不管使用哪種藥物，是 A、B 或安慰劑都一樣。

cues.en: Young people just heal faster than older people.
cues.zh: 年輕人就是比年長者恢復得快。

cues.en: That's an example of a main effect because we have an effect of one factor and it doesn't depend on the other factor.
cues.zh: 這就是主效應的例子，因為有一個因子的效果，而且不取決於另一個因子。

cues.en: Okay. Here would be an example of an interaction.
cues.zh: 接著是交互作用的例子。

cues.en: Let's say medication A works better in older people and medication B works better in younger people.
cues.zh: 假設藥物 A 對年長者效果較好，藥物 B 對年輕人效果較好。

cues.en: So now in this case, the effect of the medication depends on the age group.
cues.zh: 這種情況，藥物的效果就取決於年齡組別。

cues.en: So the effect of one factor depends on the levels of the other factor.
cues.zh: 一個因子的效果，取決於另一個因子的水準。

cues.en: So that's an example of an interaction between factors.
cues.zh: 這就是因子交互作用的例子。

cues.en: Here would be an example of an intercept.
cues.zh: 這是截距的例子。

cues.en: So symptoms improve for almost everyone after 10 days.
cues.zh: 10 天後，幾乎所有人的症狀都改善。

cues.en: Well, clinically, that is a relevant finding.
cues.zh: 從臨床上說，這是相關的發現。

cues.en: But let me give you another quick example.
cues.zh: 不過，再快速舉另一個例子。

cues.en: Let's say if we're doing an experiment where the dependent variable is height, then the intercept of the ANOVA term would be highly significant
cues.zh: 假設實驗的依變數是身高，ANOVA 項的截距就會高度顯著，

cues.en: and it would tell us that on average, people are taller than zero centimeters.
cues.zh: 告訴我們，平均而言，人的身高大於 0 公分。

cues.en: So it's sort of, it is nice to know, but it's not very relevant.
cues.zh: 知道這點也不錯，但不太有用。

cues.en: So mostly we are concerned with the main effects of the factors and the interactions between the factors.
cues.zh: 所以我們主要關心因子的主效應，以及因子之間的交互作用。

cues.en: Okay, now I want to give you a few examples of different experiments where ANOVAs would be appropriate or inappropriate.
cues.zh: 現在舉幾個不同實驗的例子，看看 ANOVA 適合或不適合使用。

cues.en: Actually, these are all examples of where you wouldn't use an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 其實以下都是不會使用 ANOVA 的例子。

cues.en: So here's our research goal: test whether people with more Facebook friends have higher self-reported extroversion.
cues.zh: 研究目標是：檢驗 Facebook 好友較多的人，自陳的外向程度是否較高。

cues.en: So personality characteristic where you are very outgoing.
cues.zh: 也就是個性很外向的特質。

cues.en: What I encourage you to do now is pause the video and determine what is the independent variable, what is the dependent variable, and what is the appropriate statistical method
cues.zh: 請暫停影片，判斷自變數、依變數，以及適合這個研究目標的

cues.en: for this research goal?
cues.zh: 統計方法。

cues.en: And you already know it's not gonna be an ANOVA, so it's gonna be something else that we've already discussed in this course.
cues.zh: 你已經知道不會是 ANOVA，所以是本課程討論過的其他方法。

cues.en: Okay, so we have two variables here, the number of Facebook friends and self-reported extroversion.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個變數：Facebook 好友數，以及自陳外向程度。

cues.en: So I say that the dependent variable is the number of Facebook friends and the independent variable is the scores on the personality questionnaire, so the self-reported measure of extroversion.
cues.zh: 我說依變數是 Facebook 好友數，自變數是人格問卷分數，也就是自陳外向程度的量測。

cues.en: Now, it's an interesting question of whether you could flip these around and say that the independent variable is the number of Facebook friends and the dependent variable is the scores on the personality questionnaire.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，能否反過來，把 Facebook 好友數當自變數，把人格問卷分數當依變數？

cues.en: Now, with only these two variables, you actually could do that mathematically, the results would be the same, but the interpretation is a little bit strange
cues.zh: 只有這兩個變數時，數學上其實可以，結果會相同，但解讀有點奇怪，

cues.en: because although this research question per se is not determining causality, there's no causality built in here experimentally,
cues.zh: 因為雖然研究問題本身不在判定因果，實驗中也沒有安排因果的驗證，

cues.en: but when we think about what would be the causal direction here, it makes sense that people's personality, which is pretty much fixed when they're kids,
cues.zh: 但如果思考因果方向，人的個性在兒童時期大致已固定，由個性

cues.en: is determining the number of Facebook friends and not the other way around.
cues.zh: 決定 Facebook 好友數，而不是反過來，似乎比較合理。

cues.en: So you wouldn't really say that you know, the number of Facebook friends you have causally changes your level of personality traits.
cues.zh: 不太會說，Facebook 好友數會因果性地改變你的人格特質程度。

cues.en: So mathematically you could swap these, but it makes more sense to have the number of friends be the the DV and the personality score to be the IV.
cues.zh: 所以數學上可以對調，但把好友數當依變數、人格分數當自變數，更有意義。

cues.en: Okay, so is this appropriate for ANOVA?
cues.zh: 這適合 ANOVA 嗎？

cues.en: The answer is no, because we don't have any categorical factors.
cues.zh: 答案是否，因為沒有類別因子。

cues.en: That's why this is not appropriate for an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 所以不適合 ANOVA。

cues.en: In an ANOVA, we want categorical factors.
cues.zh: ANOVA 要有類別因子。

cues.en: Okay, and then is it appropriate for T-test?
cues.zh: 適合 t 檢定嗎？

cues.en: No, because we don't have any groups to compare.
cues.zh: 不適合，因為沒有群組可以比較。

cues.en: You could kind of imagine setting this up like a T-test.
cues.zh: 你可以想像，把它設計成 t 檢定。

cues.en: If you wanted to split extroversion into a group of low extroverted people and a group of high extroverted people, then you could do a T-test.
cues.zh: 如果把外向程度分成低外向組與高外向組，就可以做 t 檢定。

cues.en: But this isn't really naturally a T-test situation.
cues.zh: 但這本來不是自然適用 t 檢定的情況。

cues.en: Instead, we want to do a correlation.
cues.zh: 我們應該計算相關。

cues.en: So we're looking for a linear relationship between two continuous variables.
cues.zh: 要尋找的是兩個連續變數之間的線性關係。

cues.en: So a correlation is the appropriate analysis here.
cues.zh: 所以相關才是適當的分析。

cues.en: All right, next example.
cues.zh: 下一個例子。

cues.en: Our research goal is to test whether RSI, if you're not familiar with this, this is repetitive stress injury.
cues.zh: 研究目標是檢驗 RSI，如果你不熟悉，就是重複性壓力傷害。

cues.en: This is basically the kinds of annoying chronic injuries that people develop when they have, when they repeat a particular type of movement too often.
cues.zh: 基本上，是某種動作重複太頻繁而造成的惱人慢性傷害。

cues.en: For many of us in modern times, RSIs are most prevalent as lower back problems from sitting too long with bad posture
cues.zh: 現代人最常見的 RSI，很多是因為姿勢不良、久坐造成的下背部問題，

cues.en: or wrist or elbow problems from using the mouse too much and also with less than great posture.
cues.zh: 或滑鼠用太多，加上姿勢不夠好，造成手腕或手肘問題。

cues.en: So test whether RSI is decreased for a group of people who meditate regularly versus a group of people who do not meditate regularly.
cues.zh: 研究要檢驗，規律冥想的人，其 RSI 是否比不規律冥想的人更少。

cues.en: Again, I would like you to pause the video, state what the independent and dependent variables are, and determine what analysis approach is most appropriate
cues.zh: 同樣，請暫停影片，指出自變數與依變數，並判斷最適合

cues.en: for this particular experiment.
cues.zh: 這個實驗的分析方法。

cues.en: All right, how did that one go?
cues.zh: 這一題做得如何？

cues.en: So I got that the independent variable is the group and that is meditators or non-meditators.
cues.zh: 我得到的自變數是組別，也就是冥想者與非冥想者。

cues.en: And the dependent variable is the score on the RSI.
cues.zh: 依變數是 RSI 分數。

cues.en: So this would be, I don't know, higher scores mean worse injury, something like that.
cues.zh: 例如分數愈高，表示傷害愈嚴重，類似這樣。

cues.en: Okay, so can we do an ANOVA here?
cues.zh: 這裡能做 ANOVA 嗎？

cues.en: Actually, you could.
cues.zh: 其實可以。

cues.en: This would be a case where an ANOVA is possible.
cues.zh: 這是可以做 ANOVA 的情況。

cues.en: We have a categorical independent variable and a continuous dependent variable.
cues.zh: 有類別自變數與連續依變數。

cues.en: However, when you have one factor with two levels, the ANOVA is a little bit of an overkill in this case.
cues.zh: 但只有一個因子、兩個水準時，ANOVA 有點大材小用。

cues.en: We don't actually need to run an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 其實不需要執行 ANOVA。

cues.en: It would be much simpler just to run a T-test.
cues.zh: 直接做 t 檢定簡單得多。

cues.en: We have two groups and we have a continuous random measure as the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 有兩個群組，以及作為依變數的連續隨機量測。

cues.en: So this is a perfect candidate for T-test.
cues.zh: 所以非常適合 t 檢定。

cues.en: A correlation, no, because the independent variables are discrete groups and not continuous variables.
cues.zh: 相關則不適合，因為自變數是離散群組，而不是連續變數。

cues.en: So this would not be appropriate for a correlation.
cues.zh: 所以這裡不適合計算相關。

cues.en: All right, so in this video I gave you an introduction to the ANOVA and we're going to continue this discussion in the next video.
cues.zh: 這支影片初步介紹了 ANOVA，下一支影片繼續討論。
